name: offworldnexus/blastit
description: Pins the blastit CLI in a PHP project: `vendor/bin/blastit` runs the release archive for this host, verified against a digest the package carries.

blastit.comment: composer require --dev offworldnexus/blastit is a per-project version pin, not an install method: it puts vendor/bin/blastit on PATH for local CLI handoff and composer update upgrades it.
